steps.title: Point to the arrow
steps.say: This green arrow shows the demand curve moving to the right, from D1 to D2. It is a shift, not a slide along the curve.

ops.text:
Green arrow =
the whole demand
curve shifts right

steps.title: Why it shifts
steps.say: A shift means that at every price, buyers now want more. Causes include higher incomes, a trend, or a rise in the price of a substitute.

ops.text:
At every price,
buyers want more:
higher income,
trends, substitutes

steps.title: The effect on price
steps.say: With the new curve D2 crossing supply higher up, the market settles at a higher price and a larger quantity.

ops.text:
New point: price
rises from P1 to P2
